# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean.gt",
    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean"
  )
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Load fastmixture results

```{r}
qmats <-
  readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
# check order
testthat::expect_equal(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id)
# add grouping variable
qmats$group <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$population
```

# Add continental region

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region <- "Other"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor"), "Region"] <- "Island southeast Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("BEB", "PJL"), "Region"] <- "South Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("CHS", "KHV"), "Region"] <- "East Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("ESN", "GWD", "LWK", "MSL", "YRI"), "Region"] <- "Africa"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"), "Region"] <- "Madagascar"
```

```{r}
qmats$continents <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region
```

# Find .Q values that represent African ancestry

The function calculates the average of each column in the Q matrix for all individuals within each population. Then, it subsets down to just the African populations. If the average is above 50% in any African population, it is determined to be an 'African' column. For cases where only one column is 'African' (k values 2-5 say) it assigns Merina individuals to African or Non-African depending on whether they are above or below 50%. For cases where more than one column is 'African' (K values > 5) it does a rowSum across all columns representing African ancestry, and then if the total is > 50% it assigns individuals as African.

```{r}
merina_df <- data.frame(mad_bor_g1000_sum[, c(1, 2)])
# create a dataframe of only merina individuals with "id" and "population" columns
merina_df <- merina_df %>% filter(population == "Merina")

# The function takes qmats - the gt_admix object containing a list of all Q matrices
# and a dataframe of merina individuals with "id" and "population" columns

assign_african_ancestry <- function(qmats, merina_df) {
  # Initialise a list to store which columns represent african ancestry for each run of each K
  assigned_african <- list()

  for (this_k in 2:max(range(unique(qmats$k)))) { # for each k
    # list within a list - so we have $K containing runs 1 2 3
    assigned_african[[as.character(this_k)]] <- list()
    for (this_rep in 1:rle(qmats$k)$lengths[1]) { # for each run
      # get the q_matrix
      k_run <- get_q_matrix(qmats, k = this_k, run = this_rep) %>% as.data.frame()
      k_run$id <- qmats$id # add id
      k_run$group <- qmats$group # add population
      k_run$continents <- qmats$continents # add the continent

      assigned_african[[as.character(this_k)]][[this_rep]] <- k_run %>%
        # group to calculate within each population
        group_by(group) %>%
        # get the mean of each column
        reframe(across(starts_with(".Q"), mean), continents = unique(continents)) %>%
        # filter to African populations
        filter(continents == "Africa") %>%
        # find whether mean .Q is over 0.5 in any African population
        summarise(across(starts_with(".Q"), ~ any(.x > 0.5))) %>%
        # pivot to long format
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Q_value", values_to = "flag") %>%
        # filter to those that are TRUE
        filter(flag) %>%
        pull(Q_value) # extract their column names into the assigned_african list

      # get the column names of the .Q values that represent African ancestry
      Q <- assigned_african[[as.character(this_k)]][[this_rep]]

      # if there is only one column
      if (length(Q) == 1) {
        # create column name from the current K and run
        column <- paste0(paste0("k", this_k), paste0("_r", this_rep))
        merina <- k_run %>%
          filter(group == "Merina") %>% # filter to merina
          # create a new column labelling individuals as African or Non-African
          mutate(
            !!column := ifelse(.data[[Q]] > 0.5, "African", "Non-African")
          ) %>%
          select(column)
        merina_df <- cbind(merina_df, merina)

        # if there are two or more columns
      } else if (length(Q) > 1) {
        # create column name from the current K and run
        column <- paste0(paste0("k", this_k), paste0("_r", this_rep))
        merina <- k_run %>%
          filter(group == "Merina") %>% # filter to merina
          # sum the across all columns representing African ancestry for each individual
          mutate(sum_q = rowSums(across(Q))) %>%
          # create a new column labelling individuals as African or Non-African
          mutate(
            !!column := ifelse(sum_q > 0.5, "African", "Non-African")
          ) %>%
          select(column)
        merina_df <- cbind(merina_df, merina)
      }
    }
  }
  return(as.data.frame(merina_df))
}

res <- assign_african_ancestry(qmats, merina_df)
```

Results show inconsistency, a hardcoded 50% threshold for a .Q proportion to be determined as 'African' is not ideal.

```{r}
res[20:26, ]
```

# Jason Pseudocode

1. Create a factor column in the data.frame that assigns each sample as either “African” or “non-African” based on the Population column.

```{r}
k_run <- get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 9, run = 1) %>% as.data.frame()
k_run$id <- qmats$id # add id
k_run$group <- qmats$group # add population
k_run$region <- qmats$continents # add the continent
k_run$region <- ifelse(k_run$region == "Africa", "African", "nonAfrican") # create a factor column
```

2. Loop through the ancestry columns by grabbing the column references as a list and do the following for each K to determine if it is an African K or a non-African K:

```{r}
k_evaluations <- list()

q_matrix_means <- k_run %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with(".Q"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

cols <- names(q_matrix_means)[grepl("^\\.Q", names(q_matrix_means))]

for (i in cols) {
  if (q_matrix_means[[i]][q_matrix_means$region == "African"] > q_matrix_means[[i]][q_matrix_means$region == "nonAfrican"]) {
    k_evaluations[[i]] <- "African"
  } else {
    k_evaluations[[i]] <- "nonAfrican"
  }
}
```

k_evaluations <- list()

q_matrix_means <- k_run %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(mean_K = mean(K, na.rm = TRUE))

if (q_matrix_means$mean_K[q_matrix_means$region == “African”] > q_matrix_means$mean_K[q_matrix_means$region == “nonAfrican”]) {
  k_evaluations$K <- “African” }
  else {
  k_evaluations$K <- “nonAfrican”
  }

3. Now that you’ve assigned each K column to “African” or “nonAfrican” you can make a function that takes all the K columns as inputs and returns a sum value if the column is “African”. You can then use mapply() to make a new q_matrix$Af_ancestry that will be the sum of each column assigned to African ancestry

```{r}
sum_af <- function(k_run, k_evaluations) {
  k_run$sum_af <- 0
  for (i in names(k_evaluations)) {
    if (k_evaluations[[i]] == "African") {
      k_run$sum_af <- k_run$sum_af + k_run[[i]]
    }
  }
  return(k_run)
}

sum_as <- function(k_run, k_evaluations) {
  k_run$sum_as <- 0
  for (i in names(k_evaluations)) {
    if (k_evaluations[[i]] == "nonAfrican") {
      k_run$sum_as <- k_run$sum_as + k_run[[i]]
    }
  }
  return(k_run)
}

k_run <- sum_af(k_run, k_evaluations)
k_run <- sum_as(k_run, k_evaluations)

k_run$assigned_ancestry <- ifelse(k_run$sum_af > k_run$sum_as, "African", "nonAfrican")
```


# Put it all together


```{r}
# Initialise a list to store which columns represent african ancestry for each run of each K

merina_df <- data.frame(mad_bor_g1000_sum[, c(1, 2)])
# create a dataframe of only merina individuals with "id" and "population" columns
merina_df <- merina_df %>% filter(population == "Merina")

assigned_african <- list()

for (this_k in 2:max(range(unique(qmats$k)))) { # for each k
  # list within a list - so we have $K containing runs 1 2 3
  assigned_african[[as.character(this_k)]] <- list()
  for (this_rep in 1:rle(qmats$k)$lengths[1]) { # for each run
    # get the q_matrix
    k_run <- get_q_matrix(qmats, k = this_k, run = this_rep) %>% as.data.frame()
    k_run$id <- qmats$id # add id
    k_run$group <- qmats$group # add population
    k_run$region <- qmats$continents # add the continent
    k_run$region <- ifelse(k_run$region == "Africa", "African", "nonAfrican") # create factor

    k_evaluations <- list()

    q_matrix_means <- k_run %>%
      group_by(region) %>%
      summarise(across(starts_with(".Q"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

    # get the list of column names - each .Q value in this matrix
    cols <- names(q_matrix_means)[grepl("^\\.Q", names(q_matrix_means))]

    # Assign each column African or non-African based on mean
    for (i in cols) {
      if (q_matrix_means[[i]][q_matrix_means$region == "African"] > q_matrix_means[[i]][q_matrix_means$region == "nonAfrican"]) {
        k_evaluations[[i]] <- "African"
      } else {
        k_evaluations[[i]] <- "nonAfrican"
      }
    }

    # function to sum .Q proportions from all African columns
    sum_af <- function(k_run, k_evaluations) {
      k_run$sum_af <- 0
      for (i in names(k_evaluations)) {
        if (k_evaluations[[i]] == "African") {
          k_run$sum_af <- k_run$sum_af + k_run[[i]]
        }
      }
      return(k_run)
    }
    k_run <- sum_af(k_run, k_evaluations)

    sum_as <- function(k_run, k_evaluations) {
      k_run$sum_as <- 0
      for (i in names(k_evaluations)) {
        if (k_evaluations[[i]] == "nonAfrican") {
          k_run$sum_as <- k_run$sum_as + k_run[[i]]
        }
      }
      return(k_run)
    }
    k_run <- sum_as(k_run, k_evaluations)

    # create column name
    column <- paste0(paste0("k", this_k), paste0("_r", this_rep))
    # assign African or non_African and subset to Merina individuals
    k_run <- k_run %>% mutate(
      !!column := ifelse(k_run$sum_af > k_run$sum_as, "African", "nonAfrican")
    ) %>% filter(group == "Merina") %>% select(column)
    # bind to Merina data
    merina_df <- cbind(merina_df, k_run)
  }
}
```
